title: PostgreSQL vacuum and transaction age
brief: Diagnose PostgreSQL version retention and transaction-age risk before adjusting maintenance.
outcomes: Distinguish reusable space, bloat and visibility
Choose maintenance from retained horizons and age evidence
entry: PostgreSQL tuple layout and general cleanup.

heading.title: What vacuum can reclaim
heading.brief: Follow the old P7 tuple beyond its final snapshot; inspect dead tuples, free space and file size with their measurement limits.

heading.title: What holds history open
heading.brief: Identify long transactions, replication slots and relevant horizon holders; separate preventing cleanup from generating churn.

heading.title: Visibility and index-only work
heading.brief: Relate visibility-map state to heap visits, normal writes and vacuum; measure rather than infer performance from index definitions.

heading.title: Age safety and maintenance
heading.brief: Explain freezing, transaction and multixact age, anti-wraparound work and autovacuum budgets; compare ordinary VACUUM with blocking file rewrites.
